records.proposal: Cards live on the panel, with their diagrams; the end-of-turn text no longer prints them. It says in one short line, clearly from plumb and in plumb's own colour, what changed: a new card is waiting, a card was resolved

When the panel is running, the end-of-turn text carries no card content, only one short line from plumb, in plumb's colour where the host allows colour, saying what changed: new cards waiting, answers applied; with no panel, the cards are printed in full as before
